tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | Spring Boot, REST APIs & Microservices | E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms including SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Staff Engineer
cover_en.hook: I am very excited to apply for the Staff Engineer position, bringing over 5 years of hands-on backend and enterprise e-commerce platform engineering experience built at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My background centers on designing robust Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful API solutions for complex distributed systems.

bullets.label: Robust Backend Engineering
bullets.text: Designed and implemented enterprise backend functionality using Java and Spring, covering core data management, pricing, and catalog services following platform best practices.

bullets.label: API & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Developed and exposed REST Web Services and OCC APIs for headless architectures, customized Interceptors, Populators, and Converters, and optimized complex data pipelines.

bullets.label: High-Performance Delivery
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, supported production troubleshooting, and executed CI/CD deployment cycles.

bullets.label: Agile Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Mentored junior developers, performed rigorous code reviews, and collaborated closely with cross-functional international teams in Agile and Scrum environments.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit requiring no sponsorship, and am serving my notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend and engineering expertise aligns with your team's goals.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise backend, Java, Spring Boot, and REST API engineering experience to this role. Having built, scaled, and supported complex platform architectures and data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to apply my technical depth to help your engineering team deliver high-performance, robust solutions in a remote setting.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of Java, Spring Boot, and enterprise platform engineering experience to drive robust backend solutions and scalable architectures.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am very interested in the Staff Engineer opportunity. With 5+ years of enterprise Java, Spring Boot, and REST API development experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong backend and integration expertise. Based in Germany with a valid work permit, I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Staff Engineer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Staff Engineer position. With over 5 years of professional experience engineering enterprise-grade backend systems, Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident in my ability to deliver immediate value to your team.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached for your review. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your requirements.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
